title: [FLINK-40797][table-planner] Exclude NestedLoopJoin from CBO search space for equi-joins

## Contribution Checklist

  - Make sure that the pull request corresponds to a [JIRA issue](https://issues.apache.org/jira/projects/FLINK/issues). Exceptions are made for typos in JavaDoc or documentation files, which need no JIRA issue.

You can set up Azure Pipelines CI to do that following [this guide](https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/FLINK/Azure+Pipelines#AzurePipelines-Tutorial:SettingupAzurePipelinesforaforkoftheFlinkrepository).

  - Once all items of the checklist are addressed, remove the above text and this checklist, leaving only the filled out template below.


**(The sections below can be removed for hotfixes of typos)**

## What is the purpose of the change

Exclude NestedLoopJoin from CBO search space for equi-joins when equi capable strategy exists

## Brief change log

- NestedLoopJoin (NLJ) competed on cost alone against BroadcastHashJoin/ShuffleHashJoin/SortMergeJoin, even for plain equi-joins. When the cost model underestimates cardinality (due to partial stats e.g. missing NDV/column stats), NLJ's O(m*n) cost can look artificially cheaper than a hash-based join's O(m+n) cost. In such cases, the CBO could pick NLJ for a join that has an equi-condition and an equi-capable alternative.
- checkNestLoopJoin now excludes NLJ from the candidate set whenever the join is an equi-join and has at least one equi-capable strategy.
- An explicit NEST_LOOP join hint still overrides this and forces NLJ. Also, NLJ is still applicable and evaluated for non-equi joins.


## Verifying this change

This change added tests and can be verified as follows:
  - Updated existing plan tests
  - Added new tests showing when NLJ is skipped and not skipped

## Does this pull request potentially affect one of the following parts:

  - Dependencies (does it add or upgrade a dependency): (no)
  - The public API, i.e., is any changed class annotated with `@Public(Evolving)`: (no)
  - The serializers: (no)
  - The runtime per-record code paths (performance sensitive): (no)
  - Anything that affects deployment or recovery: JobManager (and its components), Checkpointing, Kubernetes/Yarn, ZooKeeper: (no)
  - The S3 file system connector: (no)

## Documentation
